Name: Raiden Ei
Author: PhantomJoker69
Description: Hello!! This is my second ever mod for Stardew Valley and in honor of the Raiden Shogun's birthday being today I figured now would be a great time to make a public version of this mod I made as a passion project! Thanks to my two friends that helped make the sprites and the portraits (The portrait looks off and I'm terribly sorry about that idk how to fix it), The Raiden Shogun is always found at the adventurers guild (girl likes to fight so I figured it makes sense) as for her schedule she can be found at the beach, the town and also the forest! I hope you enjoy and I'll try and update her overtime to see if I can add heart events, we'll see!
